definitions.meaning: Swift as the twinkling of an eye

quotations.english: may the lightnings praise thee, pale, swift as the twinkling of an eye

source_text: breahtum-hwæt; adj. Swift as the twinkling of an eye; celer ut oculi nictus :-- Dec lígetta hérgen, bláce, breahtum-hwate may the lightnings praise thee, pale, swift as the twinkling of an eye, Exon. 54 b; Th. 192, 16; Az. 107. v. berhtm-hwæt.
